hypothesis: If the pre-target state of the historical sequence contains useful information about which registered ranking rules are locally effective, then a causal state-analog ensemble that weights rules by their performance on prior targets with similar flow states should outperform the equal-weight ensemble and the discovery-selected fixed rule on validation and blind OOS mean hits. Different rules may also alternate across high/low turbulence regimes.
primary_endpoint: mean number of actual winning numbers ranked in Top20
secondary_endpoints: mean number of actual winning numbers ranked in Top10
mean number of actual winning numbers ranked in Top5

registered_strategy_family.retrospective_oracle: one per target, descriptive only, excluded from inferential tests

adaptive_parameters.distance: Euclidean distance after robust median/MAD scaling estimated on prior states only
adaptive_parameters.kernel: Gaussian with median nearest-neighbor distance bandwidth

regime_classifier.state: RMS robust-z magnitude of current flow-state vector
regime_classifier.eligibility: conditional rule variants are eligible only when their regime matches; thresholds use prior state history only

success_definition: At least 4 of 5 actual numbers in the strategy's Top20; all5 is retained as a separate sparse endpoint.

chronology.split_rule: discovery first floor(60%); validation next through floor(80%); blind_oos remainder
chronology.target_prefix: strictly all archive rows before the target
chronology.adaptive_memory: only previously scored targets are admitted after the current target is scored

statistics.null: per-target Hypergeometric(N=40, K=5 winning numbers, n=5/10/20 ranked positions); conditional on exactly five distinct winners
statistics.p_values: one-sided continuity-corrected normal approximation to the sum of per-target hypergeometric hit counts
statistics.correction: one global Holm-Bonferroni family across 44 global strategies plus 84 conditional variants, 3 chronological splits and 3 hit endpoints; family size 1152
statistics.paired_comparison: moving-block bootstrap, block length 20 targets, 2000 replicates, fixed seed 84

selection_policy.discovery_fixed_comparator: select one fixed rule by highest discovery mean Top20 hits, ties by lower mean actual rank then stable strategy ID; freeze it before validation/OOS

limitations: The repository's historical blind OOS dates have already been inspected by earlier SONAR research; Q84 blind_oos is chronological and untouched by Q84 tuning, but not a virgin research-wide holdout.
This is a finite family built from 42 registered fixed rules plus one causal analog ensemble; it does not exhaust arbitrary mathematical rules.
Historical walk-forward is retrospective evidence, not a prospective freeze.
The exact app engine v2 is included only as an external aggregate comparator; its per-target ranks are not recomputed in this Q84 experiment.
next_action: Run the causal flow-state atlas, validate every target cutoff and rank permutation, persist exact artifacts, then obtain exact-head workflow validation and human review.
